description: Training, evaluation and deployment path. Depends on FEAT-001.
steps: Add scripts/train_throw.py: CEM/parametric trajectory optimisation and/or PPO (stable-baselines3 only if installed, otherwise own minimal implementation in torch), CLI args for --device cuda, --episodes, --out models/throw/; must run on CPU for a short smoke run (--smoke) and on A100 for full runs. Save best policy/trajectory plus a dataset of successful rollouts (state, action) for ACT distillation in LeRobot format if feasible, else npz plus converter note.

Add scripts/eval_throw.py: runs N episodes with randomised box position, prints success rate and writes results/throw_eval.json; report the measured number from a real (small) trained run in docs/11_THROW_INTO_BOX.md, honestly including failure.

Add scripts/run_throw.py: deploy path. Default dry-run against sim; real arm only with explicit --real --i-have-a-human, first executes a slow one-motor test, goes through Guard.move at Guard limits (a gentle toss at Guard speed) and refuses any faster mode unless a documented env var/flag the human must approve; never edits core.py. Optional hook to serve via server/policy_server.py (document how).
Add A100 instructions (commands, env vars A100_HOST/POLICY_API_TOKEN, no secrets) to docs/11_THROW_INTO_BOX.md.
Update CHANGELOG.md and docs/ISSUES.md (feasibility limits, untested on real arm).
Commit on branch feat/throw-into-box with specific git add paths only.
acceptance_criteria: scripts/eval_throw.py reports a success rate over >=50 sim episodes
run_throw.py without --real never touches hardware; with --real refuses without --i-have-a-human
findings: CEM (40x64x4 eps, 340 s on 16 cores) gives 85/100 in-box on held-out sim seeds, zero policy 0%. Dataset throw_dataset.npz (176/200 successes) is gitignored (models/), not committed. Background processes die after each tool call in this sandbox, run long jobs in foreground. run_throw --real never run. selftest_sim and test_policy_client pass. REVIEW 2026-11-21 FIXES (commit eea6f82): old 85/100 was a placement and is withdrawn. Env now: control_dt 0.10 (10 Hz, Guard rate), 30 steps; success = ball released (>3 cm from jaw tip) + release >= 8 cm xy from box centre + ball at rest in box (no first-contact stop); shaped +2..+8 for in-box placements. Policy is now 48-param windup+swing, clipped to 0.02..0.98. Retrained in 4 warm-started CEM rounds (~40 min, 18 cores): eval 72/100 strict (50 eps: 35/50), 92/100 in box, zero policy 0%. run_throw: box range check, plan listing, sim jaw-tip keep-out check (z>=3 cm, y>=5 cm; ASSUMED) that refuses 15/20 random boxes incl. default, start-pose check (0.1), estop on any exception. NOT fixed: plan ignores Guard 0.35 step cap (jumps up to 0.95), documented as real-arm gap; Guard.cfg.forbidden_boxes is not enforced by Guard.move so the check is in run_throw. Team files (.mcp.json, norma, etc.) untouched; three team commits (2f40610, 9cb7461, 5743ca1) appeared on this branch during the work, not made by this agent. /tmp is wiped between tool calls.
